name: NXT Retro Music
description: v1.10.2: QR client-library browsing, liked songs/saved albums/favorites, batched metadata and bounded caches; scoped context search; v1.10.1 Back behavior and original OTA sources retained.
author: Nguyễn Xuân Thông; based on Music Player by Mohammad Syuhada and nborodikhin

changelog.v1.2: SoundCloud official public API: eligible full-length tracks, track/playlist search, themed discovery, public URL resolution, native HLS AAC/MP3 playback, local bookmarks, optional matched LRCLIB lyrics, source QR, and the shared NXT PCM/DSP/DAC/background player. Requires your registered API client; live playback has not been verified without credentials.
changelog.v1.1: Spotify Premium direct playback, single QR login, shared Now Playing and mini player, Spotify/LRCLIB lyrics, account favorites, queue and NextUI background playback. Includes front TrimUI-logo exit and bottom USB DAC/charging controls.
changelog.v1.0: Approved mint / charcoal UI, offline multilingual shaping and fallback, 16 fonts, library tabs, playlist editor and graph EQ.
changelog.v1.6.1: Single-pass anti-aliased wallpaper processing, pixel mode, full preview, original cache and 24 online categories with continuous paging.
changelog.v1.7.0: 24 full native layouts; Original RGB and wallpapers; personal icons/emoji; five-band EQ presets; spectrum/LED palettes; read-only real telemetry; online catalog suggestions and playback access filtering.
changelog.v1.7.1: Device-specific native player layouts from the approved 24-interface demo; instant LED RGB/effect latch; genre EQ icons; simultaneous seven-color/mixed spectrum; cached chassis, real PCM scope and reduced redraw/log work.
changelog.v1.8: Big Update: 36 native full interfaces; saved startup avatars; mood/genre/country check-in; 300 icons and 180 3D emoji; six searchable settings groups; sectioned help and PayPal; 14 languages and offline IME; on-demand PIN Wi-Fi transfer and firmware USB-C handoff; bounded visual work.
changelog.v1.8.2: Refined compact 36-theme player, static full-sentence lyrics, source quality and actual output/DAC information, five settings groups, personal appearance hub, merged update guide, Wi-Fi transfer only; USB DAC retained.
changelog.v1.8.3: Sleep timer now saves listening progress/settings and fully exits NXT, including background playback. Releases audio and LED resources; firmware handles screen-off/suspend. Retains v1.8.2 features.
changelog.v1.8.9: Groq lyric translation alongside MyMemory/Google Cloud; separate keys, larger checked batches, quota retry headers, 512 cached songs and official Stock/NextUI OTA source migration. Existing music, themes, audio and profiles retained; NX Redux release deferred.
changelog.v1.9.1: v1.9.1: 256 MiB SD translation cache, no 512-song cap, original DSF/DFF USB DSD, Groq TXT import, original-lyrics lookup then translation, retained ROM-specific behavior and official OTA.
changelog.v1.9.3: v1.9.3: saved library opens immediately; one incremental background check, unchanged tracks skip tag reads and index writes; batched updates and Wi-Fi completion refresh. Includes v1.9.2 DSD Native/DoP fixes, DAC labels and diagnostics; retains 256 MiB translation cache, Groq TXT, all themes, ROM-specific behavior and official OTA.
changelog.v1.9.7: v1.9.7: Auralis full-cover bilingual lyrics, italic translations in both views, Xiaomi MiSans font, real 1% volume and clean volume overlay. Preserves all v1.9.3 features, DSD/DoP, indexed library, online playback, translation cache and official ROM OTA.
changelog.v1.9.7.5: Remove vocal reduction; clear retired key action safely; preserve all other listening and lyric features.
changelog.v1.9.7.6: Fix public MONETIZE SoundCloud permission handling and misleading stream errors; keep all v1.9.7.5 features.
changelog.v1.9.7.7: Refined antialiasing and artwork, larger symmetric Auralis controls, clear filled active states and bounded per-size icon caches. All listening features retained.
changelog.v1.10: v1.10: QR Spotify session catalog, valid search pagination, bounded online audio buffering, B background-or-exit dialog and paused exit; original official OTA feeds retained.
changelog.v1.10.1: v1.10.1: Now Playing B returns to the main menu; main-menu B asks background or exit while playing, and fully exits when paused/stopped. Retains v1.10 online fixes and official OTA feeds. QR library now uses the authenticated Login5 session instead of Mercury keymaster.
changelog.v1.10.2: v1.10.2: QR client-library browsing, liked songs/saved albums/favorites, batched metadata and bounded caches; scoped context search; v1.10.1 Back behavior and original OTA sources retained.
